observations: Photo 0: A black motorcycle helmet with multiple stickers, including 'REACTOR', 'PRO TAPER', and 'FACTORY FLEX'. The helmet has visible scratches and wear. A hand holds it against a tiled floor.
Photo 1: Interior view of the helmet showing gray padding, a red latch, and a black liner. The helmet appears to be in used condition with some dirt and wear on the padding.
Photo 2: Same as photo 0, showing the front and side of the helmet with stickers. The stickers are peeling and worn, indicating age or use. The helmet has a glossy finish with reflections.

claims.claim: In good conduction and you can buy and use
claims.evidence: No photo shows the helmet in use or any test of electrical or mechanical condition. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The helmet may not be in working condition or may have structural damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the helmet being worn on a head, with the chin strap fastened, and a test of the visor and internal mechanisms.

risks.risk: The helmet may have hidden cracks or damage to the shell or liner that are not visible in the current photos.
risks.proof: A close-up 360-degree video or multiple photos showing all sides, including the back and underside, under different lighting.

risks.risk: The stickers may be peeling or damaged, indicating the helmet has been used or stored improperly.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the stickers showing their condition and any damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with damaged stickers

proof_requests: Video of the helmet being worn on a head, showing the chin strap and visor function.
Close-up photos of all sides of the helmet, including the back and underside, under different lighting.
Close-up of the stickers to check for damage or peeling.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
